entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. For questions about an existing order, press one. For technical support, press two. To speak with a representative, please stay on the line.
Hi, thank you for calling VeloFit Customer Service. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hello. I need to return my VeloBand Pulse. My order number is VF55801.

I can certainly look into that for you. One moment while I pull up that order... Okay, I see it. To make sure I understand correctly, is it a technical fault with the device or more of a preference issue?
It's faulty. The heart rate tracking is all over the place, it's completely inaccurate. Honestly, the whole thing feels like a piece of garbage.

I'm very sorry to hear that. A faulty heart rate monitor is definitely not the experience we want for our customers. The first step for a defect claim is to connect you with our technical support team. They can run a quick diagnostic, and if they verify the fault, we can process a replacement right away.

Ugh, no. I really don't have time for all of that. I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for years, I just expected it to work. I just want money back, not another one. I really needed that money for something else this month.

I understand that troubleshooting is an extra step you weren't planning on, and I do see you've been a customer with us for a while, which we appreciate. I've confirmed your delivery date was 15 days ago. For the VeloBand Pulse specifically, our policy is a strict 10-day window for a direct refund for any reason.

Because your order is at day 15, we are in a window where we can absolutely process a return, but only once a hardware defect has been verified by our support team. Without that verification, it falls outside the standard return period.

So you're saying you can't help me? I spent a lot on this, and it doesn't work. I feel like I've just thrown my money away. I really thought VeloFit would stand by its products, especially for a long-time customer like me.

I truly wish I had a different answer, but my options are limited by the return policy for this specific device. Because it's been more than 10 days, a full refund is only possible if our tech team confirms a hardware failure. I can transfer you to them right now; it usually only takes them a few minutes to diagnose.
No, I just... I don't have the energy for all that. I really thought this would be simple. Fine. I guess I'm just stuck with it then.

I'm genuinely sorry we couldn't resolve this with a direct refund today. The offer to connect you with technical support is always open if you change your mind. They are the best path forward for a faulty device. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
You're welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and I do hope you have a better rest of your day.
